title: The Postnikov Spire
plays: After castle-3's outro (Null rose up the Spire), before World 4 · Level 1
synopsis: The viaduct ends high over the sea, facing the Postnikov Spire. Gyroid and Emmy look up its floors: the Cube Hall, the Grid Gallery, the Hopf Ring, Hurewicz Hall, the Twist, the Obstruction Course, and the Crown on top. Null rises out of the sea beside his tower, taller than it, and makes his claim: give him the groups and he can rebuild any space; the twists are ornament, and he will fold them first. Gyroid answers with the outro's challenge; the Chart lights a path to the first floor.

scenes.title: The viaduct's end
scenes.description: Night over the violet sea. The viaduct runs out high above the water; at its end Gyroid and Emmy face the Spire, the Crown burning at its top.

scenes.title: Looking up
scenes.description: Over their shoulders: the Spire's floors climbing into the clouds.

scenes.title: The floors
scenes.description: The camera spirals up the Spire past each terrace: the Cube Hall's sliding cubes, the Grid Gallery, the linked rings of the Hopf Ring, Hurewicz Hall's wrapped sphere, the Twist's twisted towers, the Obstruction Course's blocked cell, then the summit and the Crown.

scenes.title: Null rises
scenes.description: The Crown flares; the dawn on the horizon goes out. Count Null rises out of the sea beside his Spire, taller than it, and speaks.

scenes.title: Ready
scenes.description: Behind the pair, Null looming over the Spire. Gold Chart slabs light one by one, a path down to the Cube Hall.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: They run onto the Chart path; the camera cranes back over the Spire and Null. Title: World 4 · The Postnikov Spire.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: All night they ran the viaduct north, until it ended in the air. Ahead stood the Postnikov Spire. At its top, the Crown burned.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: That’s where he went. Straight up into the Crown.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Every floor up there wraps one dimension higher. Loops down here. Spheres above. Then spheres wrapped round spheres.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: The Cube Hall. Squares and cubes with their whole edge pinned to one point. Every one of them is a sphere in disguise.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: And those rings, higher up. Every one is linked through every other. Not one comes loose.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Near the top, the floors are twisted. Something holds them together that no single floor shows.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Emmy. Gyroid. You came all this way. I’m glad. I would hate for you to watch this from below.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Every floor of my Spire is one group. π₁, π₂, π₃. Give me the groups, and I can rebuild any space you love. The twists between them are ornament.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: So I will fold the ornaments first. Then the sky. Then you. It won’t hurt, I promise. A point has nowhere to fall.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: You said every map S³ → S² is trivial. I’m going to find one that isn’t. Then I’m coming for that Crown.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Bend it, don’t break it, and prove it. First floor, Gyroid: the Cube Hall.
